request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:FIGHTER

layers.text: Dip the toffee soldier in dark chocolate: the lower half of the toffee cube is coated in dark chocolate #4a2412 with a lighter #7a4526 highlight, with a wavy dripping edge across its middle, so the upper half with the face stays golden toffee; the knob on top and the feet are dark chocolate; the wrapper wings become cream white with thin gold stripes. Keep the face, the lollipop, the chocolate shield, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
